definitions.explanation: The year before the current one. A somewhat formal alternative to 去年 (きょねん).

examples.japanese: {昨年|さくねん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧な⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧だった。
examples.english: Last year was a tough year.

examples.japanese: {昨年|さくねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{前年|ぜんねん}→前年：23906_zennen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Last year's sales increased compared to the year before.

examples.japanese: {昨年|さくねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Last summer, our family traveled to Hokkaido.

notes:
{昨年|さくねん} is a formal synonym of ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧ (last year). Both mean the same thing, but {昨年|さくねん} is preferred in writing, news, business reports, and formal speech.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {昨年|さくねん}: last year (formal, written, news)
- ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧: last year (conversational, everyday)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昨年|さくねん}{度|ど}: last fiscal year
- {昨年|さくねん}⟦{比|ひ}→比：30310_hi⟧: compared to last year
- {昨年|さくねん}{末|まつ}: the end of last year
- {昨年|さくねん}⟦{同期|どうき}→同期：12029_douki⟧: the same period last year

RELATED TIME WORDS:
- {一昨年|おととし}/⟦{一昨年|いっさくねん}→一昨年：15474_issakunen⟧: the year before last (informal/formal)
- ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧: this year
- ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧: next year
- ⟦{前年|ぜんねん}→前年：23906_zennen⟧: the previous year (used in comparisons)
